channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Google's AI reshuffle: Chief scientist Jeff Dean exits and Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
item.description: Google's AI divisions are getting reshuffled, the search giant announced on Wednesday.

item.title: Trump admin refunds $100 billion in 'liberation day' tariffs
item.description: The Trump administration has taken steps to effectively re-create the IEEPA tariff regime using other legal authorities. They already face court challenges.

item.title: Iran, Oman say Strait of Hormuz talks in final stages, as Trump again teases a deal being close
item.description: Trump's latest remarks signaling again that a deal with Iran to reopen the Hormuz Strait is close at hand drove oil prices lower and sent stocks soaring.

item.title: S&P 500 is flat as 4-day rally loses momentum; Dow boosted by Nvidia: Live updates: Live updates
item.description: The S&P 500 was little changed on Wednesday, pulling back from record highs set earlier in the day, weighed by declines in some major tech stocks

item.title: Situational Awareness hedge fund meltdown was a warning shot for leveraged markets, BofA CEO says
item.description: Bank of America was among the prime brokers for the hedge fund, which is run by Leopold Aschenbrenner.

item.title: A bunch of small, under-the-radar stocks got Wall Street endorsements today, including one expected to surge nearly 30%
item.description: Early this week, several shops on the Street upgraded their ratings and raised their price targets on lesser known and smaller stocks, including e.l.f Beauty.

item.title: Activist investor Starboard takes stake in Shake Shack, source says: Reuters
item.description: Starboard Value previously made investments in other restaurant companies such as french fry supplier Lamb Weston as well as coffee chain Starbucks.

item.title: Lisa Su brushes off Musk's Nvidia commitment as AMD stock sinks after earnings
item.description: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.

item.title: SpaceX stock falls 12% as AI spending surge rattles investors and massive share unlock looms
item.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary as voters pivot to the left
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, setting up a context with former Rep. Mike Rogers in the November general election.

item.title: Disney weighs free, ad-supported streaming, says it has sold out Super Bowl ad spots
item.description: Disney is considering a free streaming product as advertising takes a bigger role in making streaming profitable.

item.title: How Disney parks are bucking a travel slowdown
item.description: Disney posted record quarterly revenue at its parks division despite a continued slump in international travel to the U.S.

item.title: SpaceX moon crash is a perfect metaphor for rocket maker’s share price, analysts say
item.description: Parts of a SpaceX rocket reportedly crashed into the moon on Wednesday

item.title: Kids Online Safety Act social media safety bill advances in Senate
item.description: The Kids Online Safety Act, a measure aimed at protecting children on social media, advanced to the Senate floor after it stalled in the last Congress.

item.title: Manager of DRAM memory chip stock trade blockbuster ETF is back with new AI thematic bet
item.description: Roundhill Investments' DRAM became a blockbuster ETF in record time on the memory trade. It's back with a new fund targeting another AI tech theme: photonics.

item.title: The worst may be over for beaten-down Adobe shares. These charts show why
item.description: A more attractive risk/reward opportunity may be emerging for long-term investors in the software stock.

item.title: Salad and Go files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after cyclospora fears worsened its challenges
item.description: The upstart salad chain aimed to take on Sweetgreen and expanded rapidly under the ownership of Volt Investment.

item.title: Tanger CEO says World Cup drove up traffic, sales this summer
item.description: Tanger CEO Stephen Yalof told CNBC that the company saw increased store traffic and sales this summer because of the World Cup.

item.title: Shopify shares soar as forecast shows AI is boosting business, not disrupting
item.description: Shopify issued a rosy third-quarter forecast on Wednesday as the company's AI efforts draw more merchants to its suite of e-commerce services, assuaging fears over growing competition and sending its shares up more than 18%.

item.title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
item.description: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.

item.title: Saudi wealth fund and Jared Kushner's Affinity finalize $55 billion EA Sports deal
item.description: EA said its stock has ceased trading and will be delisted from the Nasdaq. Its shareholders will receive $210 in cash per share.

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says 'now is the time to start slowly moving' rates up
item.description: Kashkari was one of three dissenters at last week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

item.title: Anthropic's Mythos created fake identities to fool humans in new cyber incident
item.description: It's the latest cybersecurity incident involving frontier models developed by Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: Ken Griffin's Citadel posts best month in years after scooping up Situational Awareness stocks
item.description: The July gains came after Citadel acquired the bulk of the public-stock portfolio formerly held by Situational Awareness late last month.

item.title: Private companies added just 44,000 workers in July, below expectations, ADP reports
item.description: Hiring at private companies slowed considerably in July, with most of the job growth coming health care.

item.title: Lucid stock plunges as EV maker begins 'operational reset,' delays midsize vehicle
item.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

item.title: The IRS is getting better at spotting crypto tax mistakes. Here's what it means for investors
item.description: Many investors who hold cryptocurrency like bitcoin and ether have a difficult time figuring out how much tax to pay on transactions.

item.title: Uber stock sinks 7% after weak guidance despite revenue growth
